predecessors.note: Infobox 'Established: July 4, 1894', when the Provisional Government of Hawaii had ended; Cliopatria's Republic row begins only in 1895.

land.text: all the Hawaiian Islands: 'The transfer of sovereignty over the Hawaiian islands took place on August 12, 1898'

successors.note: The Newlands Resolution 'was approved on July 4, 1898, and signed on July 7 by McKinley'; the Territory of Hawaii was formally established on June 14, 1900.

capitals.name: Honolulu
capitals.note: Infobox 'Capital: Honolulu'; the seat was the former royal Iolani Palace (the US flag was raised 'over the former royal Iolani Palace' in 1898).

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1894: Cliopatria's Republic row starts in 1895, but the infobox gives 'Established: July 4, 1894'. Same shape as 1895 (24,850 km2, identical to the Kingdom's 1811-1893 shape). The page gives no area, so the shape cannot be compared with an infobox figure.

24,850 km2 for 1895-1897: all the Hawaiian Islands, as the Kingdom's last shape. The page has no area figure and no mention of Wake, Palmyra, Johnston or the north-western islands, so the extent beyond the main islands is unverified.
New keyframe 1898: Cliopatria stops in 1897, but the Republic lasted until 12 August 1898 ('The transfer of sovereignty over the Hawaiian islands took place on August 12, 1898'). Same shape.

ledger.note: 1894: the Republic of Hawai'i replaces the Provisional Government. Infobox 'Established: July 4, 1894'; 'Article 23 of the 1894 constitution specifically named Sanford B. Dole as the republic's first President', and he 'would also be the nation's only President'.

1898: the Republic is annexed by the United States. 'The transfer of sovereignty over the Hawaiian islands took place on August 12, 1898' (the Newlands Resolution 'was approved on July 4, 1898, and signed on July 7 by McKinley'); the US flag was raised over Iolani Palace.

wars.name: Wilcox rebellion of 1895 (royalist counter-revolution)
wars.outcome: A royalist attempt to capture the government buildings (infobox 6-9 January 1895); arms and ammunition landed from San Francisco and later found at Washington Place. The Republic continued to 1898.
wars.note: No ground was held by the royalists on the page; no territorial effect.

certainty.note: An island archipelago; the coast is the border.

sources.title: Republic of Hawaii
sources.note: Established 4 July 1894, capital Honolulu, Dole, 1895 counter-revolution, Newlands Resolution 7 July 1898, transfer 12 August 1898, Territory of Hawaii 14 June 1900. No area on the page.

notes: Written 2026-10-18 from one page (budget 1-2). Cliopatria's Republic row (1895-1897) is the Kingdom's last shape unchanged; the page gives the Republic's life as 4 July 1894 to 12 August 1898, so two keyframes (1894, 1898) are added. No area is given by the page: the 24,850 km2 shape is accepted on the Kingdom of Hawai'i dossier's reading (same shape since 1811), not on a figure from this page. The page says nothing about islands beyond the main group (Wake, Palmyra, Johnston, Lisianski, Necker, Nihoa), so none is entered. The 1893 annexation treaty and its failure are not described on the page. Provisional Government (predecessor) and Kingdom dossiers are written by oc-01; the successor is the United States row (united-states-of-america, Cliopatria), whose dossier should record the 1898 gain. Native names left empty: the page gives none.
